name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council implementing the bilateral safeguard clause of the EU-Mercosur Partnership Agreement and the EU-Mercosur Interim Trade Agreement for agricultural products
part_text:
The EU has agreed a trade deal with the Mercosur countries of South America. This report sets out Parliament's position on a backup plan for farm products: if cheap imports suddenly flood in and hurt EU farmers, the EU can act. Parliament wants the EU Commission to watch imports more closely, react faster, and step in sooner when imports jump or prices fall.

- The Commission must check imports constantly and report every three months instead of six.
- Investigations into harm to farmers would take three months, not six, and emergency measures come within 14 days.
- The evidence needed to start a case is halved: a 5% rise in imports or price drop, not 10%.
